description: Map layers used by research/freshwater/assets/map.js. Public layers are requested live from the provider's service (nothing large is copied into this repository). Every layer states provider, dataset, version, resolution, coverage and known limitations. check_status records the last time a tile or image was successfully requested from the service near Allen Branch.

default_view.note: Centered between the U.S. Census geocoded campus address and the NHD-mapped Allen Branch centerline. Not a sampling location.

records.name: USGS Topo
records.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
records.dataset: USGS Topo cached base map (USGSTopo MapServer)
records.resolution: Multi-scale cartographic base map; detailed to about 1:9,000
records.limitations: Cartographic generalization: lines are drawn for legibility, not survey accuracy. Roads and names come from several national datasets of different dates.

records.name: USGS Imagery
records.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map (USDA orthoimagery)
records.dataset: USGS Imagery Only cached base map
records.limitations: Leaf-on summer imagery hides narrow shaded streams under canopy. Imagery date varies by tile.

records.name: Kentucky aerial imagery 2022 (2 ft)
records.provider: Commonwealth of Kentucky, Division of Geographic Information (KyGovMaps); imagery from USDA NAIP
records.limitations: Single growing-season acquisition; canopy obscures small channels; not a substitute for field confirmation of flow or channel location.

records.name: Terrain — KyFromAbove hillshade (5 ft)
records.limitations: Shaded relief shows landforms (valleys, sinkholes, road fills) but no elevation values; it does not show where water flows underground.

records.name: Streams & waterbodies (NHD)
records.dataset: National Hydrography Dataset, high resolution (nhd MapServer)
records.limitations: Mapped centerlines, not field surveys. Perennial/intermittent/ephemeral classes come from map compilation and may not match current flow. Small headwater channels and karst conduits are often missing.

records.name: Watershed boundaries (HUC 8 / 10 / 12)
records.limitations: Hydrologic units are surface-topography units; a 12-digit unit is not the drainage basin of any particular small stream. In karst, groundwater can cross these boundaries.

records.name: Land cover — NLCD 2021
records.limitations: 30-m pixels cannot resolve a narrow riparian corridor. 'Pasture/Hay' and 'Cultivated Crops' classes describe land cover, not management, fertilizer use or livestock density, and say nothing about whether runoff reaches a stream. No land-cover percentages are calculated on this site until a basin is properly delineated.

records.name: Karst potential (1:500,000)
records.dataset: KY500KKarstPotential_WGS84 — 1988 Geologic Map of Kentucky formations styled by karst potential
records.limitations: Regional generalization from a 1:500,000 map; boundaries can be off by hundreds of meters and must not be used to judge a single site.

records.name: Mapped sinkholes
records.dataset: KYSinkholes — sinkhole outlines digitized from topographic contours
records.limitations: Only depressions large enough to show on topographic contours are mapped; many small or filled sinkholes are missing.

records.name: Springs (Kentucky Groundwater Data Repository)
records.provider: Kentucky Geological Survey (data from the Kentucky Division of Water)
records.limitations: Only springs that have been reported to the repository; locations vary in accuracy.

records.name: Wastewater plants & outfalls
records.dataset: Ky_Wastewater_WGS84WM (layers: Wastewater Treatment Plants, Package Treatment Plants, WWTP Outfalls)
records.limitations: Wastewater infrastructure inventory, not the complete list of discharge permits (KPDES). Industrial, stormwater and agricultural permits are not shown. A nearby facility does not establish that it affects a given stream.

records.name: USGS stream gages
records.limitations: Includes inactive as well as active gages; check USGS Water Data for current status. No gage is mapped on Allen Branch.

records.name: Water-quality monitoring locations (WQP)
records.dataset: Station search, HUC 051301030204 — saved extract data/geo/monitoring-locations.geojson
records.resolution: Point locations as reported by each organization
records.limitations: Registered monitoring locations, not proof of current or recent sampling. Kentucky Division of Water sites appear twice (21KY and 21KY_WQX). None is on Allen Branch.

records.name: Allen Branch — NHD centerline & flow direction
records.dataset: data/geo/allen-branch-nhd.geojson — Allen Branch (GNIS 00485848) and mapped downstream reaches
records.coverage: Allen Branch and Sinking Creek to the Pitman Creek artificial path
records.limitations: Status: Mapped — not field-verified. Arrows follow NHD's digitized flow direction. The intermittent classification and the downstream connection have not been confirmed in the field, and karst may divert flow underground.

records.name: Campus street address (geocoded)
records.limitations: An approximate position for the street address only. It is not the campus access point to the creek, not a sampling station, and not field-confirmed.

records.name: Field observation points
records.resolution: GPS position recorded with each observation, with stated accuracy
records.limitations: Empty until the first field visit is recorded and reviewed.

not_available.reason: No public statewide culvert inventory was found. Roads appear on the USGS Topo base map; culverts on Allen Branch need a field inventory.

not_available.layer: Upstream drainage area of Allen Branch
not_available.reason: Not yet delineated. To be produced with USGS StreamStats (or lidar-based delineation in QGIS) and stored with its method and date.
Not available as a public layer found so far; requires municipal records or field inventory.
The wastewater layer above is an infrastructure inventory, not the full permit list. EPA ECHO facility search is the next source to integrate.
None established yet. Stations will be added after field reconnaissance with GPS coordinates and stated accuracy.
